scripts.sync:web: cd .. && npm run build && npx cap copy electron
scripts.electron:start: npm run sync:web && npm run build && electron ./
scripts.electron:pack: npm run sync:web && npm run build && electron-builder build --dir -c ./electron-builder.config.json
scripts.electron:make: npm run sync:web && npm run build && electron-builder build -c ./electron-builder.config.json -p always
